# WoHoTech — AI-Readable Site Index
# https://wohotech.in
# Last Updated: July 2026

## About WoHoTech
WoHoTech (wohotech.in) is an Indian ed-tech platform offering:
- Free computer science and engineering subject courses (DSA, OS, DBMS, Networks, AI, ML, etc.)
- 125+ free online tools (calculators, converters, PDF tools, SEO tools, image tools)
- 800+ coding practice problems with online judge
- WoHoPlay — a creator-focused social video platform
- WoHo AI — an AI assistant with chat, image generation, and file Q&A
- Technical news and updates (technicals section)

## Primary Audience
- Indian engineering students (B.Tech, BCA, MCA, diploma)
- Competitive programmers (LeetCode, Codeforces prep)
- Job seekers preparing for GATE, campus placements, FAANG interviews
- Web developers and self-learners
